title: Rosemary Beach: Rally Win Cottage & Carriage House in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Rally Win Cottage & Carriage House in Seacrest Beach
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the large Lagoon Pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Located park-side in the famous Seacrest Beach community is Rally Win - a bright, beachy six-bedroom house and carriage house that seamlessly blend indoor/outdoor areas, making this a perfect destination for friend and family getaways!

With an open concept living/dining area in the main house, gathering together for meals and movies couldn't be easier. Located just off the kitchen is the first guest bedroom, with a King-size bed and its own en suite bathroom. Also on this floor is the washer and dryer. Continuing upstairs is yet another living area, with a 55'' Smart flat screen TV - the perfect place for morning coffee, afternoon aperitifs, or movies for the kids. Open the French doors to invite an ocean breeze in from the large balcony. You'll also find three additional plush bedrooms; two, King-size bedrooms with their own en suite bathrooms, and a bunk room that features two sets of twin-over-twin bunks.

The carriage house accommodates up to four, with a Queen-size guest bedroom, and a set of bunk beds just off of the kitchen/living area. The full-size kitchen including stainless steel appliances, and room for four at the kitchen island; cooking with the family couldn't be easier! The living area, complete with a 55'' flat-screen TV, is the perfect place to cozy up in after a day in the sun.

With incredible indoor/outdoor space, screened in porch, hardwood floors throughout, designer tile floors in all bathrooms and a state of the art kitchen, this newly constructed home will be a destination your family will return to year after year! A variety of dining and shopping options are available just a short block and half (2 minute walk) away in Seacrest. Dining and shopping is also within walking distance in both Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. With everything at your fingertips, some guests elect not to rent a car.

Discover the truly spectacular white sand beach just a short five-minute walk away, or take the complimentary shuttle for pick up/drop off at your private beach access! When you're ready for a break from the beach, take a refreshing dip in the 12,000 square foot lagoon pool is just steps away from the home, and enjoy the Seacrest Beach Café at the pool. Hop on one of the 6 complimentary bikes to explore the 19-mile bike path along the famous 30A Highway, or enjoy one of the many shops, restaurants, or fun events that Seacrest has to offer. Even though Rally Win Cottage is not in the Rosemary Beach community, you will still have complimentary access to the Fitness facilities and tennis courts for the duration of your stay. This is truly where memories are made!

Why not start setting things in motion so you can have a beautiful and memorable Florida vacation with the ones you love?! You too could soon be relaxing on our pristine beach when you contact Rosemary Beach at (866) 348-8952 or book your stay in Rally Win Cottage & Carriage House online today!

*Rally Win rents 7 nights, Saturday-to-Saturday during Spring Break and Summer Seasons*

*No access to Rosemary Beach walkovers or pools*
